title: A better way to win.
intro: We turn anyone who touches your brand into a voracious advocate: a buyer who comes back, and can’t wait to tell someone why.

stages.body: Someone meets your brand for the first time.
They understand what you do and why it matters.
They choose you, for a reason they can repeat.
They buy again, and tell others why.

approach.title: Growth starts with understanding your market
paragraphs: Fangled Group helps you win in the U.S. and abroad with a strategy-first method. We find your ideal customer segments, define what they need, and build a data-driven go-to-market plan around it.
The result is a launch, domestic or global, that’s planned, priced, and protected before it spends a dollar.

slides.text: Voice-of-customer, distributor, and dealer studies reveal what buyers actually value.
Findings become a clear value proposition, and a reason to choose you over every alternative.
Marketing and sales get one data-driven plan, and move on it together.

fractionalCmo.title: Top skills and performance at a fraction of the cost.
paragraphs: Imagine a C-level marketing executive fully dedicated to your company, without the cost of a full-time hire or the team built around one.
Don’t mistake an agency for a Fractional CMO. An agency is a vendor hired for tasks. A Fractional CMO is a fiscally responsible member of your executive team who owns the strategy and the budget.
capabilities: Technology review and implementation: CRM, marketing automation, web design, and SEO
Voice of the market, channel partners, and the competitive landscape

fitCheck.title: Does this sound like your business?
painPoints: Your Sales team is often distracted from actively selling by trying to create their own materials or being bogged down in marketing admin.
You lack inside expertise to gather and interpret market data.
You have had issues recruiting a seasoned professional.
Your marketing needs have peaks and valleys you wish could scale without hiring and firing.
You have had communication issues and financial creep managing agencies not involved in daily operations.
You plan to eventually hire a VP Marketing or CMO but need a head start on your go-to-market plan.
You have several business units that do not require an individual marketing executive for each.
You just purchased or acquired a business that requires a jump start, rebranding, or turnaround strategy.
fitCheck.hintOne: One is often enough for a Fractional CMO to pay for itself.
fitCheck.hintMany: {count} at once is exactly what a Fractional CMO is built for.
